questions.question: What is the correct order of the parts of Freytag's pyramid?
options: Exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution
Climax, exposition, resolution, rising action, falling action
Resolution, falling action, climax, rising action, exposition
Rising action, exposition, climax, resolution, falling action
questions.explanation: A plot typically follows exposition, rising action, climax (the turning point), falling action and resolution.

questions.question: What is a "dynamic" character?
options: A character who changes during the story
A character who moves around a lot
A character who appears in every scene
A character who speaks loudly
questions.explanation: A dynamic character changes through the story, while a static character remains the same.

questions.question: What is the difference between a round and a flat character?
options: A round character is complex and multi-dimensional; a flat character is simple
A round character is overweight; a flat character is thin
A round character is evil; a flat character is good
A round character appears at the end; a flat character at the start
questions.explanation: Round characters are complex with many traits, while flat characters are simple and one-dimensional.

questions.question: In a literary analysis essay, what should each body paragraph contain?
options: One point supported by evidence from the text and an explanation
A new summary of the whole story
Only your personal feelings
As many quotes as possible without comments
questions.explanation: Each body paragraph should make one analytical point, support it with textual evidence and explain how the evidence supports the point.

questions.question: What is "foreshadowing"?
options: Hints about what will happen later in the story
A description of the weather
The story's final sentence
A summary at the beginning
questions.explanation: Foreshadowing gives the reader hints about future events, building tension and expectation.
